sections.title: Changed
items: Add top and bottom linear gradient fade masks to the synced and plain lyrics scroll containers so scrolling lyrics blend smoothly into the border instead of clipping abruptly.
Reduce Now Playing album art scale so the playing state uses the previous paused size (0.92x) and the paused state shrinks to 80% of that size (0.736x).

sections.title: Fixed
items: Clip and fade-mask MarqueeText to its container bounds rather than the inner fixedSize scroller width so scrolling titles never bleed across adjacent controls.
Keep a fixed 44-point trailing frame and 8-point spacing for the Now Playing 3-dot options menu so long song titles stop and fade cleanly before the menu button.
